VALE MANOR — UPKEEP. Paid by the Ashcroft Trust, Portland.

Mon 21 Sept. Grass. Gutters (east). Turret lamp trimmed.
Mon 5 Oct. Roof slate over the library. Turret lamp.
Mon 19 Oct. Front lock oiled. Lamp & matches on the porch table for the visitor, per Mr. T. Mercer. Turret lamp trimmed & left burning.

Standing instructions (copied each year, as asked):
— Keep the turret lamp lit. (E.O., 1937)
— Mondays only. Never in the house after dark.
— Do not open the west wing.
